product_metadata.title: WISLIFE Kitchen Shear - Best Stainless Steel Kitchen Scissors for Poultry, Seafood, Scallop, Herb, Scissoring, Dishwasher Safe Culinary Scissors
features: MULTIPLE USES: WISLIFE kitchen shear can be used as a cake and butter cutter, bone cutter, can opener, herb scissor, vegetable peeler, screw driver, bottle opener and nut cracker.

EASILY TAKE APART: Open our heavy duty kitchen scissors' two blades up to 90 degrees, the kitchen shear just becomes two separated knives, which allow for efficient cleaning and debris removal! The two separated blades can be very convenient while cutting cake or butter, sharpening and slicing stuff.
TIME SAVER IN KITCHEN: Our come apart kitchen shear is combined with 8 useful functions, they are absolutely time savers in and out of kitchen, no more need to spend time to find other tools!

HIGH QUALITY: WISLIFE's chicken shears are made of heavy duty, long-lasting carbon stainless steel metal. This makes it one of the best stainless steel kitchen scissors you can find in terms of reliability and value.

COMFORTABLE & SAFE: WISLIFE leather shears have a perfectly made, soft grip handle, this ensures its cutting accuracy and efficiency. And it's absolutely dishwasher safe. The magnetic holder ensures the seafood shear is beyond your beloved kids' reach. Just put this kitchen scissor on your fridge.
